final_system_state.process_visibility_note: Docker Desktop (docker-desktop) has a different process view from the AlmaLinux WSL shell. Engine-process confirmation uses docker top; WSL ps alone is insufficient.

notes: Both model configurations use the same production executable. Weight contents and compatible MTP artifacts differ.
Official v0.23.0 settings; one warmed sample per speed cell. Windows Balanced; native Linux power controls unavailable under WSL.
Loading cache method is POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED and verified mincore, not the generic drop_caches note emitted by the upstream driver.
Single prose AR/MTP parity and concurrency fresh-AR parity are intra-model checks; cross-model output equality is not required.
